topic.title: Why a Trading Journal Can Improve Your Learning Loop

research.summary: A useful trading journal records the setup, the reason for the decision, the risk, the outcome, and what you would change next time. The point is not to collect screenshots. The point is to identify repeated behavior. A journal turns random experiences into a feedback loop that can help you study your own process.
